evidence.source: Satoyoshi (2018), Analysis of Price Fluctuations in the Nikkei 225 Futures Market: Night Session and Day Session, OSE/JPX Futures & Options Report
evidence.published_result: Lagged overnight USD/JPY change EX_R(-1) has a significant negative coefficient in the day-session futures-return regression: coefficient -0.264, Newey-West t=-2.637.
evidence.independence: External FX predictor; not the futures-own overnight return, not prior-SPX path, and not intraday momentum/reversion.

fx_predictor.boJ_definition: USD/JPY spot rate at 17:00 JST, Tokyo market, yen per USD
fx_predictor.fed_definition: Japanese yen per USD noon buying rate in New York City
fx_predictor.alignment: For OSE trading date D, choose the latest calendar date t strictly before D for which both BOJ 17:00 JST and Federal Reserve noon-NY observations exist on t.

target.definition: OSE regular day-session open-to-close log return
target.open: open of first source 1-minute bar at historical OSE day-session open
target.close: close of final source 1-minute bar before historical OSE day-session close

stage_a.rationale: Strict post-publication-sample holdout ending before exact JNU Micro confirmation period.

primary_test.directional_accuracy: Among nonzero FX signals and nonzero target returns, fraction signal sign equals target-return sign; expected > 0.5

stage_a_pass_rule: At least 900 usable post-paper OSE Mini days.
stage_b_pass_rule: Stage A PASS is mandatory; otherwise Stage B statistics are prohibited.
At least 500 usable exact-JNU Micro days.
Identical FX definition, alignment, signal and target; no retuning.
diagnostics_non_promotional: OLS slope of OSE day return on FX overnight return; expected negative.
Post-2024-11-05 OSE session-extension diagnostic in Stage B.
Gross signal payoff distribution before trading costs.
forbidden: Change the FX measurement times after outcomes.
Use BOJ 9:00, current-day Tokyo FX, NY close, or intraday FX alternatives as rescue.
Add NY Dow, S&P 500, HAR-RSV, BOJ-event, VIX, volume or technical filters to rescue G1.
Threshold FX changes by magnitude after outcomes.
Flip the signal sign after outcomes.
Use night-session target instead of day-session target as rescue.
Use exact-JNU Stage B to rescue a failed Mini Stage A.
Claim tradable alpha before downstream execution/cost/overfit/forward validation.

interpretation.pass: If both stages pass, promote only to a directional information candidate. A concrete executable rule must still pass downstream execution/cost/overfit/forward stages.
interpretation.fail: Close current family. Reopen only with substantively new independent evidence, not FX-time/filter/sign/threshold rescue.
